basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: GTM Builder & Integrated Campaigns | Built AI Outbound Systems at Scale | 3× Founder | MBA
basics.summary: Unusual profile for an Integrated Marketer role: I built the AI outbound system marketing teams use. At LumApps I own the production multi-agent outbound stack (2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast quarterly), including personalized sequences, ABM-shaped targeting, and instrumentation that tells us within a week if a channel is working. At Beekeeper I co-owned GTM launches with Sales and PM (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis, Employee Lifecycle) and ran demo systems that generated personalized content per account. MBA (93.2%), 4 international conference talks, and 3 AI products founded on the side. Bias to ship, translate positioning into copy, and measure what actually moved pipeline.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Built and shipped the production AI outbound system SDRs use every day. Personalized sequences, ABM-shaped targeting from Salesforce/HubSpot, and channel instrumentation. Result: 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue.
Own campaign analytics end to end: cost-per-request, conversion funnels, tracing, and per-vertical breakdowns. Kill what does not work; scale what does.
Cross-functional with Sales, Product, and RevOps. Report directly to C-level on pipeline outcomes, not activity.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.position: Senior Software Engineer (Technical Lead) & GTM Co-Owner
highlights: Co-owned cross-functional GTM launches with Sales and PM: Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis, Employee Lifecycle. Every launch shipped with instrumentation so we knew within a week if it moved pipeline.

Architected Employee Referral System end to end and ran its GTM. Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR. Direct engagement with enterprise buyers from discovery through post-launch.

Built GenAI demo generator that auto-produced personalized, on-brand content per account from Salesforce data. Improved demo speed and close rates; the same personalization playbook translated into email and ad creative.
Replaced $337K/yr in vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline. Unlocked localized content and campaigns in new languages without a gatekeeper. Bias to ship.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups for seed-to-VC decisions, including their GTM strategies, positioning, and campaign readiness.
Advised portfolio companies on translating product positioning into channel-ready campaigns and building instrumentation to prove pipeline impact.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Founding engineer at a startup. Turned prototype demos into enterprise partnerships (Unilever) and event marketing wins (CES Las Vegas showcase). Every partner conversation shaped the next campaign narrative.
Owned brand-adjacent surfaces (operator UI, partner-facing materials) alongside the full-stack build.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Integrated Marketer at ElevenLabs for the Eleven Agents product line. Build multi-channel campaigns (paid, email, webinar, events) for 2-3 verticals. Turn product positioning into campaign assets, partner with product marketing/paid media/sales, own pipeline and conversion. 3+ yrs B2B demand gen at high-growth software/AI company.
_jobApplication.notes: UNUSUAL FIT: candidate is an engineer + MBA + founder, NOT a traditional marketer. Reframed as 'builder who built the AI outbound tool marketing uses' + 'MBA-trained cross-functional GTM co-owner at Beekeeper' + '3 founded products = ran their marketing solo' + 'speaker/writer track record'. JD says 'potential > past experience' — leaning into that. RISK: they may filter for standard demand-gen background. Recommend a strong cover letter framing this as a builder-turned-marketer angle.
